role: ACT-R-based confidence dynamics for COMPUTES_TO instance edges in PKG knowledge graph (Layer 3).
detail: Implements the Anderson & Lebiere (1998) base-level learning formula for procedural memory confidence: effective_confidence = min(1.0, base + k * ln(n) - d * ln(hours + 1)). Four stateless functions compute confidence values: calculate_confidence() applies the core formula with per-type decay rates and clamping; apply_guardian_confirmation() returns high confidence (0.60+) for guardian-validated facts that unlock direct recall; should_use_direct_recall() checks if confidence exceeds 0.50 threshold; hours_since() parses ISO timestamps to compute elapsed hours for decay. Key thresholds: BASE_PROCEDURAL=0.15 (new unconfirmed), BASE_GUARDIAN_CONFIRMED=0.60 (crosses threshold), procedural_cap=0.52 (max without confirmation), RETRIEVAL_THRESHOLD=0.50. Per-type decay rates: D=0.05 (default), WORD_FORM_DECAY_RATE=0.04, PHRASE_DECAY_RATE=0.03, CONCEPT_PRIMITIVE_DECAY_RATE=0.02. All writes to the graph (edge updates) are performed by ProcedureExecutor, not this module.
gotchas: Prior procedural_cap of 0.48 created extinction hole where genome-bootstrapped actions (0.55) decayed to 0.48 and fell below retrieval threshold permanently; bumped to 0.52 to provide 0.02 stability buffer. hours_since() returns 0.0 on unparseable timestamps or missing values rather than raising. All functions assume UTC/ISO format timestamps with optional timezone awareness.
